_comment: Layout for the 塔科夫Scav city preset 'city_small'. tools/spike/CityStructureGen.java reads every
tools/city-layout*.json and produces, from the same in-memory block grid, BOTH the datapack
structure (data/tarkovscav/structures/<name>.nbt) and the RCON command lists
(tools/spike/work/<name>_commands.txt and <name>_platform.txt) - so the .nbt and the sandbox build
can never drift apart. Edit this file, re-run the generator, and all of them are regenerated.
Blocks are named by SEMANTIC KEY, never by block id: the key -> block mapping is the two palettes
in CityStructureGen (EXTERIOR_MODERN / INTERIOR_SCAV), picked here with "palette". That is the one
place to change the look of every building at once.
Every building is checked by StructureNbtTest for: an accent corner, a working rooftop ladder, a
framed door whose sill is a full block with wall on both sides, and at least min_cover_per_floor /
min_furniture_per_floor cover and furniture blocks on EVERY floor.
Deliverables B / C / G (2026-09-26): the keys below are the opt-in switches for the indoor fixtures and
the interior variation. They are layout-level defaults; a building entry overrides any of them.
interior_variation        0 (off) or 1: the room grid is drawn from the seed instead of being exactly
rooms_x x rooms_z - the partition count moves by -1..+1 per axis, every
partition is jittered, and extra 1x2 openings are punched between rooms;
extra_openings_per_wall   0..N extra 1x2 openings per partition wall (0 when absent);
floor_holes_per_floor     1..N 1x1/1x2 holes per UPPER floor, cut through the slab. A hole is a real
vertical connection: the connectivity report must reach every floor with
the ladder shaft treated as a wall, or the generator refuses the layout;
spawners_per_building     1..N minecraft:spawner block entities per building (TROOP tier only),
spawner_budget            optional whole-layout cap on the spawner count,
chests_per_building       1..N minecraft:chest block entities per building (loot table
minecraft:chests/abandoned_mineshaft - never a copy of it).
name: city_small
